# Right-clicking a header menu's arrow opens the browser's context menu

## Context

An outside user tried the 13.3.0 issues showcase after the release announcement, and the operator relayed the report on 2026-10-21. With a column's value menu open, right-clicking the header's arrow shows the browser's own context menu (Back, Forward, Reload…) on top of the value menu.

Reproduced on neomjs.com 13.3.0, at `dist/production/examples/grid/issues/index.html`. A `contextmenu` event dispatched on the State header button is default-prevented, so no browser menu appears. The same event on that header's arrow (`.neo-grid-menu-trigger`) is not.

## The Problem

#19643 lets a header open its value menu with a right-click. The arrow is part of that same control, yet a right-click on it falls through to the browser. That puts two menus on screen at once.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.mjs:90` adds `neo-grid-menu-enabled` to the header button.
- `Menu.mjs:119-122` registers that class as a `contextmenu` default-prevention target through `Neo.main.DomEvents.registerPreventDefaultTargets`.
- `src/main/DomEvents.mjs:539` prevents the default only when the event path contains a registered class.
- The header's vdom is wrapped (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:366`, `.neo-grid-menu-wrapper`). The arrow is created with the wrapper as its parent (`Menu.mjs:93`), which makes it the button's sibling. Its event path therefore never contains the button, or `neo-grid-menu-enabled`.

## The Fix

Make a right-click on the arrow behave like one on the header:
- the browser menu stays closed, either by also registering `neo-grid-menu-trigger` as a `contextmenu` target or by moving the class to the wrapper;
- the value menu opens, or stays open.

Check which component the plugin's `contextmenu` listener reaches when the event starts on the arrow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A right-click on a header's arrow never shows the browser's context menu, and it opens the value menu, or keeps it open, as a right-click on the header does.
- [ ] AC-2: Headers without a value menu are unchanged. Their behaviour is decided separately.
- [ ] AC-3: A browser test proves AC-1 and fails on `dev`. `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` runs the showcase in the engine tier, without the Neural Link, and can read the event's `defaultPrevented`.

## Out of Scope

Right-click on headers that have no value menu (that is a separate ticket), and the menu's content.

### @Jah-yee - 2026-10-21T12:38:31Z

Claiming this one, so nobody duplicates the work.

Plan (small, two files):

- `src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.mjs`: the trigger is a native sibling of the sort button, so the event path of a right-click on the arrow never contains the `neo-grid-menu-enabled` element the plugin registers as a `contextmenu` prevent-default target — the browser menu shows up. Register `neo-grid-menu-trigger` next to it, and let the plugin's own `contextmenu` handler see the arrow's event, so the value menu opens the same way a right-click on the header opens it.
- `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs`: the browser test for AC-1 — the arrow's `contextmenu` is `defaultPrevented`, and the value menu opens.

Headers without a value menu stay untouched (AC-2), since the plugin only exists for headers that have one.
